title: Fert, 4th Green
last_load: PGR + Fert, Fairways, 9 to 10 Nov, on Blue nozzles. It had iron sulphate and GreenMaxx in it: flush the tank, boom and filters with clean water first
site_check: Spray sign out at the 4th green. Green mown, clippings and debris cleared
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind under 15 km/h · Delta T was 1.5 at 4:45am: check the 6th-green station before you spray
extra_checks: The 5800 last ran Blue on fairways. Red AIC is the 300 L/ha greens setup
Tank, boom and filters flushed with clean water
The fairway tanks had iron sulphate in them. This mix is alkaline, and iron left in the lines can drop out as sludge
No GPS on the 5800: box out the 4th green, then fill in

products.why: Buffering agents go in first, into plain water with the agitator on, before the fertilisers. You're at {before} L.
Big solid: goes in early, into plain water, so it's fully dissolved before the liquids go in. The tank will go cold. You're at {before} L.
Strongly alkaline. Goes in once the GroMaxx is fully dissolved, agitator running. You're at {before} L.
Strongly alkaline. In after the kelp, agitator running. You're at {before} L.
Goes in last, as the sheet has it. Its label says check compatibility before tank mixing: watch the tank as it goes in. You're at {before} L.

ppe_note: High K and Pro Kelp are strongly alkaline and irritate eyes: goggles, PVC gloves and apron when you pour them. Buff-It: no label on file, so treat it as an acid and read the drum label: goggles and elbow gloves. GroMaxx dust irritates eyes: goggles on when you tip the bags. Eyewash on the rig.
spray_rules: 4th green only: 800 m², about 24 L. No GPS on this sprayer: box out the green (a lap round the edge), then fill in
Dew off the green first, clippings and debris cleared
Check Delta T at the 6th-green station before you spray: it was 1.5 at 4:45am and needs to be 2 to 8. If it's still under 2 at 7, call Andy. Stop if it's blowing off target
Shotgun start is 8:00 and groups reach the 4th about 8:15. Be off the green before then and keep people off it until it's dry
Foliar pass: do NOT water in. No irrigation or hand watering on the 4th for 24 h
About 76 L will be left in the tank. Check with Andy where it goes before you spray it out
spray_more: Pro Kelp and Phoz Fight labels give their rates in 700 L of water per ha and both say check compatibility before tank mixing. GroMaxx: let every bag dissolve before the next product goes in.
post_checks: 4th green irrigation off for 24 h and nobody hand watering it
Foliar pass: it has to stay on the leaf

flags.t: Sheet changed since Thursday: 100 L tank, Buff-It in for Companion
flags.d: The GreenKeeper sheet now covers 3,333 m² (100 L) and has Buff-It 500 mL/ha in place of Companion. This page was rebuilt from the sheet at 5am Friday. The sheet's notes still say 'QUARTER TANK - 300 L': that line is out of date. Buff-It is last on the sheet; the page has it first, into plain water.

flags.t: Brief says 'watered in'. The sheet says do NOT water in
flags.d: This morning's #dailycoursesetup brief says to make sure the 4th is 'watered in and dry' before the 8:15 groups. The sheet is a foliar pass: do not water in, no irrigation on the 4th for 24 h. This page follows the sheet.
flags.s: #dailycoursesetup dawn re-check 13 Nov · GreenKeeper sheet notes

flags.t: Delta T 1.5 at 4:45am, spray on the board for 7am
flags.d: SpecConnect 6th station at 4:45am: 13.5 °C, RH 85%, Delta T 1.5, wind SSE 2 km/h, heavy dew. It needs 2 to 8 before the boom goes on. The board has mix 6:30 and spray 7:00, ahead of the 8:00 shotgun; groups reach the 4th about 8:15.
The 4th is 800 m², about 24 L at 300 L/ha. The 100 L tank leaves about 76 L, enough for about 2,500 m². Andy to say where it goes.

GroMaxx at 44 kg/ha is 20.2 kg N/ha (0.202 kg per 100 m²). Andy asked for 0.2; GreenKeeper rounds 43.5 kg/ha up to 44. High K adds 2.6 kg N/ha, so the tank is 22.9 kg N/ha. The 5 Nov greens tank ran GroMaxx at 50 kg/ha in the same water volume.

High K is potassium carbonate (pH 12.4–12.8) and Pro Kelp is pH 10–12.5. GreenMaxx came off the sheet because carbonate drops its iron and magnesium sulphate out as sludge. The 5800's last tanks carried iron sulphate and GreenMaxx, so the tank, boom and filters get a clean-water flush before this fill. Buff-It at 500 mL/ha won't hold the pH down against 40 L/ha of alkaline product.

flags.d: Foliar pass, no water-in. Friday night's greens irrigation needs the 4th green's heads held. About 2 mm of rain is forecast from 8pm Friday.

flags.t: Boom setup: about 317 L/ha at 4 bar
flags.d: Toro's own colour code: Red is the 0.4 gpm size (1.51 L/min at 2.76 bar). At 4 bar that's about 1.82 L/min a nozzle; on 50 cm spacing at 6.9 km/h it's about 317 L/ha. The rate controller will sit near 3.6 bar to hold 300 L/ha.
